title: Seerah timeline strip
subject: Islamic Studies
source: Written for islamic-studies/y4 lessons 4, 5, 6 (Seerah timeline strip (printable, built up across the unit))
intro: Lesson 4: Arabia before Islam, the birth and childhood of the Prophet ﷺ. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

panels.title: Makkah before Islam
points: The Ka'bah was full of idols
Some girls were wronged; the weak were not protected

panels.title: The Year of the Elephant
points: An army with an elephant came
They wanted to destroy the Ka'bah

timeline.label: Baby
timeline.text: Cared for by Halimah in the desert

timeline.label: Age 8
timeline.text: Grandfather Abd al-Muttalib died; uncle Abu Talib cared for him

blocks.text: Add events as the unit goes on: the trader years, marriage, Hira, the first believers, the public call.

keywords.def: the city of the Ka'bah where the Prophet ﷺ was born
a child whose parent has died
the year an army with elephants tried to destroy the Ka'bah

questions.q: Order: Abu Talib, Halimah, Abd al-Muttalib, Aminah dies.
questions.a: Halimah, Aminah dies, Abd al-Muttalib, Abu Talib

questions.q: Which surah tells the story of the elephant?
Give one fact about Makkah before Islam.
questions.a: For example: the Ka'bah was full of idols.

questions.q: Add four events to your seerah timeline strip, each with a short caption.
questions.a: Birth in the Year of the Elephant; Halimah; mother dies at 6; Abu Talib from 8.

questions.q: Extend: how did Allah care for the young orphan?
questions.a: He gave him loving carers: Halimah, his grandfather and his uncle.

questions.q: Stretch: Allah asks, 'Did He not find you an orphan and give you refuge?' (ad-Duha 93:6). What does this teach us about orphans?
questions.a: Allah cares for orphans, so we must care for them too.

questions.q: Who looked after him from the age of eight?
questions.a: A) His uncle Abu Talib. His mother died when he was six; Halimah cared for him as a baby; Abu Talib from age eight.

questions.q: The Prophet ﷺ was born in ...
Think again: who did he need, and who did Allah give him?
questions.a: Loving carers: Halimah, his grandfather and his uncle Abu Talib.
